blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Power supply issues persist in the Visayas on Tuesday, with a fresh red alert declared over the grid. In an advisory, the National Grid Corp. of the Philippines said the Visayas would be under red alert anew from 5 p.m. to 7 p.m. READ: Power supply woes in Visayas, Mindanao extend to September A yellow alert would also be in effect from 3 p.m. to 5 p.m., and 7 p.m. to 8 p.m. The grid operator raised electricity alerts as three coal plants went offline and imports from Mindanao remained limited.
